title: A Function-Space Stability Boundary for Generalization in Interpolating Learning Systems
abstract: arXiv:2602.03514v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Modern learning systems often interpolate training data while still generalizing well, yet it remains unclear when algorithmic stability explains this behavior. We model training as a function-space trajectory and measure sensitivity to single-sample perturbations along this trajectory. We propose a contractive propagation condition and a stability certificate obtained by unrolling the resulting recursion. A small certificate implies stability-based generalization, while we also prove that there exist interpolating regimes with small risk where such contractive sensitivity cannot hold, showing that stability is not a universal explanation. Experiments confirm that certificate growth predicts generalization differences across optimizers, step sizes, and dataset perturbations. The framework therefore identifies regimes where stability explains generalization and where alternative mechanisms must account for success.

translated_title: 插值学习系统中泛化的函数空间稳定性边界
translated_abstract: 现代学习系统通常能够对训练数据进行插值，同时仍保持良好的泛化能力，然而算法稳定性何时能解释这一现象仍不清楚。我们将训练过程建模为函数空间中的一条轨迹，并测量沿该轨迹对单样本扰动的敏感性。我们提出了一个收缩传播条件，并通过展开所得递归得到一个稳定性证书。较小的证书意味着基于稳定性的泛化，同时我们还证明了存在风险较低的插值情形，其中这种收缩敏感性不可能成立，这表明稳定性并非一种普适的解释。实验证实，证书的增长能够预测不同优化器、步长和数据集扰动下的泛化差异。因此，该框架识别出了稳定性可以解释泛化的情形，以及必须借助其他机制来解释成功的情形。
tldr: 该论文提出函数空间稳定性证书来刻画算法稳定性何时能解释插值学习系统的泛化，并证明存在稳定性无法解释的低风险插值区域，从而界定了稳定性解释的适用边界。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a function-space stability certificate to characterize when algorithmic stability explains generalization in interpolating learning systems, and proves the existence of low-risk interpolating regimes where stability cannot hold, thereby delineating the boundary of stability-based explanations.
